source.description: PROBLEM: The bead path renders a refusal as the SPECIALIST_DISPATCH_REJECTED envelope (with AgentSession line); the inline-contract path renders the identical underlying refusal as a bare {status, reason, missing} object. A coordinator cannot pattern-match refusals across the two paths, and anything parsing refusals must know which path produced it. Refusals are rendered, not projected — the shared-success-projection property does not cover them. Split from unitAI-rrdnt.55 notes (second defect), which keeps the stale-build identity question separate and fixable without touching this.\n\nSCOPE: Rough — the two refusal renderers (extension rejectionResult/inlineRejectionResult + Claude activation.tool.ts rejectionResult) and what one shared refusal shape would be. Needs exploration before promotion; do not execute as written.
source.title: Bead vs inline dispatch refusals render the same refusal in two shapes
